name: DC Hub - Data Center Intelligence
description: Real-time data center intelligence: 12,500+ facilities, 126,000 substations, live grid demand for all 7 US ISOs (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, NYISO, SPP, ISONE), transmission lines, fiber routes, gas pipelines, NEPA filings, M&A pipeline, and AI infrastructure deals. The only MCP server combining facility, infrastructure, and live grid data into one queryable interface for AI agents doing site selection, energy analysis, or market research.

tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Search and filter 50,000+ global data center facilities by location, capacity, operator, market, and more. Try: search_facilities operator=Equinix country=US

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific data center facility including capacity, power, connectivity, and operator details. Try: get_facility id=1234

tools.name: get_market_intel
tools.description: Market intelligence including supply/demand, pricing, vacancy rates, absorption, and pipeline data for major data center markets. Try: get_market_intel slug=northern-virginia

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Track 21+ GW of data center construction pipeline globally — announced, under construction, and planned capacity. Try: get_pipeline company=AWS state=OH

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Retrieve M&A transactions in the data center industry including buyer, seller, deal value, capacity, and market.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Curated data center industry news aggregated from 40+ authoritative sources. Try: get_news topic=hyperscale

tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Evaluate a geographic location for data center suitability — power, fiber, climate, water, carbon, tax incentives, and market dynamics. Try: analyze_site lat=39.04 lon=-77.49

tools.name: compare_sites
tools.description: Compare 2-4 locations for data center suitability side-by-side across all infrastructure dimensions. Try: compare_sites lat1=39.04 lon1=-77.49 lat2=33.07 lon2=-96.81

tools.name: get_energy_prices
tools.description: Retail electricity rates, natural gas prices, and grid reliability data by state and market. Try: get_energy_prices state=VA

tools.name: get_grid_data
tools.description: Real-time electricity grid data for US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, etc.) and international grids. Try: get_grid_data iso=ERCOT

tools.name: get_infrastructure
tools.description: Nearby power infrastructure — substations, transmission lines, gas pipelines — for any US location. Try: get_infrastructure metro=columbus

tools.name: get_fiber_intel
tools.description: Dark fiber routes, carrier networks, lit services, and connectivity intelligence across 20 major data center markets. Try: get_fiber_intel format=geojson

tools.name: get_renewable_energy
tools.description: Renewable energy capacity data — solar farms, wind farms, and combined generation by state and market. Try: get_renewable_energy fuel=solar state=TX

tools.name: get_tax_incentives
tools.description: Data center tax incentives by US state — sales tax exemptions, property tax abatements, and other incentive programs. Try: get_tax_incentives state=OH

tools.name: get_water_risk
tools.description: Water stress and drought risk assessment for data center locations using USGS and climate data. Try: get_water_risk state=TX
